procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Lighthouse Tower Modification works at Manakkodam Lighthouse

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to reach office by 22.09.2026 1500 hrs. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body; OR, for contractors from Lakshadweep Group of Islands, experience in island works with any Government department during last 7 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%
Similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of residential, institutional or office building, road etc. or other related civil construction works
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF / labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
